candidate_policy: Retain the frozen AV2 matrix, strengths, NP/CT parameters, exact exports and internal ranker without any preference-driven change.
primary_descriptive_hypothesis: R1's first-seed CT-over-additive overall preference may repeat on the other calibration seed and held-out padwork. This is not a general-quality or default-selection claim.
comparison_policy: Report all seven arms per pair/seed and all six dimensions. Preserve ties, missing labels and repeated-control variation; shared clips and overlapping pairs are not independent trials. Compare NP/CT with additive, stable winner and individual adapters, not just base.
allowed_preference_free_work: Render the remaining 24 physical held-out clips serially on the existing local server when its queue is idle.
Verify prepared/executed graphs, whole-clip decode, streams and review-remux fidelity.
Prepare separate blinded review pages without displaying held-out clips or frame grids.
Perform frame-waveform diagnostics on already-reviewed calibration clips; retain uncertainty and do not convert them into audiovisual preferences.
not_authorized_by_this_record: Fitting candidate selection to held-out outputs or inventing human labels.
Expanding the render matrix, rerolling undesirable clips or changing model/runtime profiles.
Changing disconnected behavior, installing updates, publishing, committing, pushing or version bumping.
